authorship.origin: manual transcription of LMI GoPxL 1.3-1.5 manual literals (and LMI Classic support-screenshot literals labelled as corroboration) plus independently chosen asymmetric values, authored without reading any Capturefab GoPxL source

conventions.value: scaled_i32 / 1000 as an exact decimal string with exactly three fractional digits; no float
conventions.leading_zeros: accepted in M, V and D digits and recorded verbatim in raw_*_text
conventions.after_wire: reply bytes are written in a single write; 'close' then closes the peer, 'keep_open' leaves it open with no further bytes
conventions.error_text: ERROR remainder after 'ERROR'+delimiter, permitted trailing delimiter removed, otherwise verbatim; '' when no delimiter follows ERROR
